summary: validate_implementation.py defines ROOT from the execution-plan location; EXPECTED requires five refactor-acceptance toolchain files (policy, projection script, prerequisite schema, and two tests); missing files yield failure family implementation-not-present and no authorizations; six registered Python commands must all exit zero, including targeted tests, unittest discovery, package validation, quick validation, and workflow-model routing validation; any nonzero command yields registered-command-failed with recent output and no authorizations; success emits schema version jimuyun.refactor-acceptance-toolchain-implementation-validation.v1 and predicate implementation-complete; success authorizes only implementation-complete; acceptance-passed, release, and archived remain explicitly unauthorized; ambiguity: subprocess command availability and repository contents are runtime-dependent.
